event.description: Coil fouling: UA_clean multiplier reduced to 0.6 (40% fouling)
event.expected_consequences: Temperature held near SP by cascade; steam flow and/or TV-101 open further; CALC-UA falls; CALC-APPROACH may rise if duty same but effective UA lower.
event.competing_explanations: Steam header pressure drop (PI-201/TI-201 would move); TT bias (redundant TI-102 vs TIC; steam would not need to rise for true T).
